description: KY-040 rotary encoder: TIM4 encoder mode 3 on PB6 (CLK) / PB7 (DT, module pull-ups), 4 counts per detent, prints 'pos=<n>' at every new detent and the debounced push switch on PB12
expect:
72 MHz. TIM4 encoder mode 3 (TI12, IC1F = IC2F = 15), ARR 65535, PB6/PB7 floating inputs (the KY-040 has 10 kOhm pull-ups; both pins are 5 V tolerant), PB12 input with pull-up (SW). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'KY-040: CLK PB6, DT PB7 (TIM4 encoder), SW PB12
' then 'pos=0
'. The main loop wakes every SysTick (WFI) and prints 'pos=<CNT/4>
' whenever the signed 16-bit count is a multiple of 4 and differs from the last report (clockwise: CLK falls before DT -> up). PB12 low for 20 ms prints 'SW pressed
', back high for 20 ms 'SW released
'.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
KY-040: CLK PB6, DT PB7 (TIM4 encoder), SW PB12
pos=0

scenarios.name: one detent clockwise (CLK leads DT) reports pos=1
